main_text.p: Dnrunt. Tertiò sacerdotes & judex populi summus simul in hoc judicio confederunt. Hodie in con-cilio soli Sacerdotes sedent & statuunt, principes seculares astare, & jussa tantùm, vel decreta con-cilii, instar apparitorum & lictorum, capessere atque exsequi jubentur.

NequeConstantinuArium; Thuum, commad Ephesinuad Chalcedont EpiscopoQuemadmodum igitur duplex subjectionisMagistratus & ministe-rii subjectio reciproca. genus est, spirituale, & politicū: ita spirituali, vel ecclesiasticā, quae fidei est & obedientiae, juxta Dei verbum, magistratus, tanquā ecclesiae membrum, subjicitur ministerio ecclesiastico. Quemadmodū David, Joas, Josias, Philippicus Arabs, Theodosius, Valentinianus, Arcadius, aliíque Impp. Christiani, Prophetis Dei, & Episcopis sese submiserunt. Estque vox Valentiniani memoriā digna, qui, cūm mortuo Auxentio, Mediolanensi Episcopo, de praeficiendo altero Episcopos obtestaretur, ita eos alloquitur: Talem in Pontificali constituite sede, cui & nos, qui gubernamus Imperium, sincerè nostra capita submittamus, & ejus monita, dum tanquam homines deliquerimus, necessario, veluti curantis medicamenta, suscipiamus, ut est lib. 7. tripart.hist.cap.8. Politicā verò, vel civili subjectione magistratui subjiciuntur ecclesiae ministri, quatenus homines & cives sunt, cum facultatibus ac possessionibus suis.

page.notes: The left margin is cut off at the scan edge; the fragments are transcribed as far as they are visible and may be incomplete. Their order and line position are approximate. The right margin note is set in small type across three lines, with a hyphen at the line end. Long s has been normalised to s. The italic passage runs through the line breaks. Printed "con-" hyphens at line ends are kept. The running head is taken from the left "regalibus" and the right "CAPUT V.".
